BAE Systems delivers technology-led defence, aerospace, and security solutions. The Graduate Naval Ships Software Engineer will produce software architectures and designs, implement software solutions, develop and execute tests, integrate software with target hardware, and support lifecycle and product maturity activities.
Aerospace
Manufacturing
National Defense
Military
National Security
Navigation
Responsibilities
As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for producing software architectures and designs based on the requirements of each ship, implementing solutions using a variety of programming languages and development tools
The role involves designing and developing software tests to demonstrate functionality, robustness, and performance, as well as carrying out software testing and integration with target hardware
You will also support lifecycle and product maturity activities, including participation in design reviews, helping to ensure that software solutions meet both technical requirements and operational objectives throughout their development
Qualification
STEM degree
Required
As a minimum requirement you must have obtained, or be predicted to obtain, a 2:2 Bachelor's degree or a pass at Master's level in the following subjects: in any STEM subject
All applicants must as a minimum achieve Baseline Personnel Security Standard
